stem.text: An experiment is carried out using a metal wire to investigate how it responds to a varying tensile force. The cross-sectional area of the wire is constant.
Which graph has a gradient that is equal to the Young modulus of the metal?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis extension and horizontal axis force, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the upper right.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis force and horizontal axis extension, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the upper right.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis stress and horizontal axis strain, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the upper right.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis strain and horizontal axis stress, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the upper right.
